sources.title: 《人间词话》（1926年版）：境界、视角与真切
sources.authorOrInstitution: 王国维（1877—1927）；核查版本为中文维基文库
sources.rights: Public domain in the United States and jurisdictions with copyright terms of life plus 80 years or less; Wikisource explicitly marks this edition public domain. Only original pedagogical abstractions and a link are stored.
sources.credibility: high for modern Chinese literary thought; contemporary story-writing transfer requires human review

sources.title: Writing the Photoplay
sources.authorOrInstitution: J. Berg Esenwein and Arthur Leeds; rights record hosted by Project Gutenberg
sources.published: 1913; Project Gutenberg eBook released 2006 and updated 2020
sources.rights: Project Gutenberg marks eBook 17903 public domain in the USA. The knowledge base stores no source prose, only original pedagogical abstractions and a link.
sources.credibility: historically important primary craft source; only durable visual-story principles are adopted and silent-era rules are explicitly excluded

sources.title: 《随园诗话》卷三：修改、停顿与原意
sources.authorOrInstitution: 袁枚（1716—1797）；核查版本为中文维基文库
sources.published: 清代；网页版本持续维护
sources.rights: Yuan Mei's original works are public domain worldwide because the author died more than 100 years ago; Wikisource explicitly marks the author accordingly. Only original pedagogical abstractions and a link are stored.
sources.credibility: high as a primary classical Chinese revision source; modern classroom transfer is independently authored and bounded

sources.title: Common Core State Standards for English Language Arts & Literacy
sources.authorOrInstitution: National Governors Association Center for Best Practices and Council of Chief State School Officers
sources.rights: The standards are copyrighted and offered under a public license for uses supporting the initiative, with attribution and scope conditions; examples may contain third-party material.
sources.rejectionReason: Used only as a standards-alignment reference. No standard text or examples were ingested into the Yu knowledge modules, and no endorsement is claimed.

sources.title: 《义务教育语文课程标准（2022年版）》
sources.authorOrInstitution: 中华人民共和国教育部
sources.rights: Official and publicly downloadable, but this review did not locate an explicit commercial reuse or AI-training permission for the attached curriculum-standard text.
sources.rejectionReason: Human decision recorded 2026-09-19: keep this source as an external alignment reference only unless written commercial knowledge-extraction permission is obtained. No curriculum text, examples, or assessment language may enter Yu's runtime knowledge base, and no endorsement may be claimed.

sources.title: Writing Framework for the 2017 National Assessment of Educational Progress
sources.rights: The official PDF is publicly accessible, but this review did not find an explicit public-domain or reuse statement inside the document.
sources.rejectionReason: Authoritative but rights basis is not explicit enough for ingestion under the Yu training policy. No text or framework content was added.

sources.title: 《文赋》
sources.authorOrInstitution: 陆机（西晋）；核查版本为中文维基文库
sources.published: 西晋；网页版本持续维护
sources.rights: Underlying work is public domain worldwide; Wikisource explicitly marks it public domain, with site text under CC BY-SA.
sources.rejectionReason: Rights are acceptable, but the current extract substantially overlaps the existing 文心雕龙 craft-and-revision module. Deferred to avoid redundant training.

sources.title: Writing Guide with Handbook
sources.rights: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 plus an explicit page notice prohibiting use in LLM or generative-AI training without permission.
sources.rejectionReason: StoriesLens is a commercial product and does not have OpenStax permission for AI training. No content was ingested.

sources.title: Previously supplied commercial writing books
sources.rejectionReason: Keep only independently authored method summaries already in code; do not copy, redistribute, or add source text until rights and editions are verified.

sources.title: The Art of Story-Telling
sources.authorOrInstitution: Julia Darrow Cowles; rights record hosted by Project Gutenberg
sources.published: 1914; Project Gutenberg eBook released 2021 and updated 2024
sources.rights: Project Gutenberg marks eBook 66303 public domain in the USA.
sources.rejectionReason: Rights are acceptable, but the historical child-directed moral framing and oral-storytelling guidance overlap current IES oral-to-written support. Deferred until a narrow, modern, non-prescriptive listening-and-retelling module is justified.

sources.title: 《闲情偶寄·词曲部》：结构、宾白与格局
sources.authorOrInstitution: 李渔（1611—1680）；核查版本为中文维基文库
sources.rights: Underlying work is public domain worldwide because the author died more than 100 years ago; Wikisource page text is available under CC BY-SA 4.0.
sources.rejectionReason: Potentially useful for Chinese drama structure and dialogue, but its historical prescriptions require a bounded modern transfer review. Deferred rather than adding overlapping or culturally dated rules to Yu.

sources.title: Toolkit to Support Evidence-Based Writing Instruction in Grades 2 Through 4
sources.authorOrInstitution: Regional Educational Laboratory program, Institute of Education Sciences, U.S. Department of Education
sources.rights: Officially published and freely accessible through IES; the reviewed page describes the toolkit as derived from the already adopted public-domain WWC elementary writing practice guide. No toolkit files or templates were copied into this repository.
sources.credibility: high; current U.S. federal implementation toolkit grounded in the adopted WWC evidence practice guide
sources.rejectionReason: Deferred because its writing-time, writing-process, gradual-release, choice, feedback, collaboration, and publishing practices substantially overlap the adopted IES modules. No new runtime module was justified by this review.

sources.title: 《培智学校义务教育生活语文课程标准（2016年版）》
sources.authorOrInstitution: 中华人民共和国教育部
sources.rights: Official and publicly downloadable, but this review did not locate an explicit commercial reuse or AI-training permission for the curriculum-standard text.
sources.credibility: high for its intended special-education context; official Ministry of Education curriculum standard
sources.rejectionReason: Potentially relevant to accessible oral-to-written support and individualized participation, but it applies to a specific special-education context and lacks explicit reuse permission. No text, examples, or assessment language entered Yu's runtime knowledge base.
